line: My Lord, I take my leave.
If it's just, if more thou dost perceive, let me know more.
Sit on thy wife to observe.
My lord, I would I might entreat your honor to stand this thing no farther.
Although it is fit that Cassio have his place, for sure he fills it up with great ability.
Yet, if you please to hold him off a while, you shall by that perceive him and his means.
